title: DUET CSE Carnival 2026: Participating in the National ICT Olympiad
excerpt: Representing Southeast University at the DUET CSE Carnival 2026 in the National ICT Olympiad alongside university friends, batchmates, seniors, and juniors at DUET, Gazipur.
author: Fazley Rabbi
cover_alt: Southeast University delegation of students, seniors, and batchmates in front of the DUET CSE Carnival 2026 banner at DUET campus.
body:
## Stepping into DUET CSE Carnival 2026

On **26 June, 2026**, I had the exciting opportunity to participate in the prestigious **National ICT Olympiad** at the **DUET CSE Carnival 2026**, hosted by the Department of Computer Science and Engineering at the **Dhaka University of Engineering & Technology (DUET), Gazipur**.

The carnival brought together talented engineering students and tech enthusiasts from universities across the country for a celebration of technology, algorithmic thinking, and problem-solving excellence.

## Southeast University Delegation and Team Camaraderie

Our journey from Southeast University to DUET was one of the most memorable parts of the experience. A vibrant delegation of students — spanning close friends, batchmates, seniors, and enthusiastic juniors — traveled together by university bus to represent our institution.

The mutual encouragement, sharing problem-solving strategies during the commute, and taking group photos on the lush green campus grounds strengthened the bond among our programming and CSE community.

## Testing Knowledge at the ICT Olympiad

The ICT Olympiad presented a wide array of challenging questions covering computer science fundamentals, data structures, algorithms, emerging technologies, and logical deduction. Competing under timed conditions alongside sharp minds from across Bangladesh was a rewarding test of knowledge and analytical agility.

Receiving the **Certificate of Participation** from DUET was a proud milestone that motivates me to keep exploring cutting-edge computing topics and participating actively in national tech arenas.

These photographs capture the Southeast University delegation in front of the DUET CSE Carnival backdrop, the university team travel bus, and the official carnival kit and ICT Olympiad certificate.
